title: Polymer thin film-embedded metal oxide-modified electrochemical paper-based sensor for glycine detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15630-15638
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01870F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zaheer Ahmad, Abdullah K. Alanazi
A simple electrochemical paper-based sensor (ePAS) using mPEG-b-PLG/CdO quantum dots enabled selective glycine detection. Wax-printed channels and carbon/silver electrodes made this green, reusable, and low-cost platform suitable for real samples.
